  • Constructor Details

    • MemberReport

      MemberReport(String name, boolean active, double gearRatio, double speedRpm, double powerW, double inletFlowM3PerHr, double inletPressureBara, double outletPressureBara, double requiredDischargeBara, double distanceToSurge, double distanceToStoneWall, double requiredRecycleFraction, double recyclePowerW, boolean surge, boolean stoneWall, boolean speedWithinRange, List<String> flags)
      Constructor.
      Parameters:
      name - compressor name
      active - true when in service
      gearRatio - member rpm per shaft rpm
      speedRpm - member speed [rpm]
      powerW - member shaft power [W]
      inletFlowM3PerHr - inlet actual flow [m3/h]
      inletPressureBara - suction pressure [bara]
      outletPressureBara - discharge pressure [bara]
      requiredDischargeBara - process discharge need [bara], NaN if not set
      distanceToSurge - fractional distance to surge, NaN if unavailable
      distanceToStoneWall - fractional distance to stonewall, NaN if unavailable
      requiredRecycleFraction - recycle fraction needed to reach the control line
      recyclePowerW - power spent on that recycle [W]
      surge - true if at or beyond surge
      stoneWall - true if at or beyond stonewall
      speedWithinRange - true if the member speed is inside its minimum/maximum speed
      flags - textual flags
